Quick sizing summary (two options):

1) Minimal pilot (fastest lead time — provisioned by w/c 2026-06-08)
- Node spec: 4 x A10G-equivalent nodes (or GPU SKU we have mapped to balanced latency/cost)
- GPU count: 16 GPUs total (4 GPUs/node assumed), mix tuned for 7B-heavy inference
- Sustained QPS: ~90 QPS at 70% 7B, ~30 QPS for 13B (effective blended sustained ~80–95 QPS)
- Burst capacity: short bursts to ~200 QPS if we allow aggressive batching + opportunistic overlay on hosted spare capacity; p95 latencies will increase during bursts.
- Cost/time: ~2–3 week lead time for staging + 2–3 day bake; pilot monthly run-rate estimate: ~$48k/month (infrastructure only).

2) Resilient pilot (more headroom, SLA-friendly — provisioned by w/c 2026-06-01 if we reserve)
- Node spec: 6 x A10G-equivalent nodes
- GPU count: 24 GPUs total
- Sustained QPS: ~140 QPS blended; handles 200 QPS bursts without relying on hosted overlay; p95 latencies within targets with proper KV caching.
- Cost/time: requires reservation by 2026-06-01 to hit 6/15 go-live; monthly run-rate estimate: ~$72k/month (infrastructure only).

Notes and tradeoffs:
- GPU SKU: we recommend A10G-equivalent for this pilot given cost/latency profile; if customer insists on higher memory (e.g., 13B finetuning/resident caching) consider 80GB-class GPUs but that increases cost x1.6–2.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for 13B to reduce sustained compute; this reduces required GPU headroom by ~20–30% for that model slice.
- Quantization: 4-bit/8-bit quantized models align with these estimates; bring-your-own model artifacts will need quantization validation which may add 3–5 days.
- KMS/HSM: if AstroGrid requires customer-managed keys, this becomes a Private deployment path and adds ~2–3 weeks for key integration and procurement review.

Recommended ask back to customer: confirm whether bursts are short (<30s) and whether KMS is required for pilot. If they confirm short bursts and no KMS, we can propose Minimal pilot with a clear extension path to Resilient pilot if utilization spikes.

I can convert numbers into the workbook and drop a second tab with cost assumptions for Ben.

-karthik
